ai_overview.markdown:
![Are Guys Supposed To Wear Engagement Rings? | Goldsmith Jewelers](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-c7349b64c4bc:4)
`Yes, men do wear engagement rings` , and the practice is becoming increasingly common.[[1]](https://www.reeds.com/do-men-wear-engagement-rings.html)

### Tradition vs. Modern Trends

- **Traditional view:** In Western cultures like the United States, engagement rings were historically given only to women, while men waited until the wedding day to wear a band.[[1]](https://www.reeds.com/do-men-wear-engagement-rings.html)[[2]](https://www.weddingwire.com/wedding-forums/at-what-point-does-a-man-wear-his-ring-after-getting-engaged/83a2d2389ce35aba.html)
- **Global customs:** In many other parts of the world—such as Sweden, Chile, and Argentina—both men and women have long expected to exchange engagement rings as a sign of mutual commitment.[[1]](https://www.betterhelp.com/advice/relations/do-men-wear-engagement-rings/)[[2]](https://modgents.com/blogs/ringsandthings/do-men-wear-engagement-rings)
- **Current shift:** Couples today frequently rewrite these traditions, choosing to celebrate their engagement equally with rings. As noted in a discussion on [WeddingWire](https://www.weddingwire.com/wedding-forums/at-what-point-does-a-man-wear-his-ring-after-getting-engaged/83a2d2389ce35aba.html) , users on forums note that while it diverges from old American customs, it is now a matter of personal choice.[[1]](https://www.danarebeccadesigns.com/blogs/drd-blog/do-men-wear-engagement-rings)[[2]](https://nelsoncoleman.com/blogs/blog/do-men-wear-engagement-rings-a-look-at-history-culture-and-changing-traditions)[[3]](https://www.weddingwire.com/wedding-forums/at-what-point-does-a-man-wear-his-ring-after-getting-engaged/83a2d2389ce35aba.html)

### Styles and How They Are Worn

- **Designs:** Men's engagement rings range from simple metal bands (like titanium, tungsten, or gold) to more distinct styles featuring diamonds, matte finishes, or unique inlays.[[1]](https://nelsoncoleman.com/blogs/blog/do-men-wear-engagement-rings-a-look-at-history-culture-and-changing-traditions)[[2]](https://www.danarebeccadesigns.com/blogs/drd-blog/do-men-wear-engagement-rings)
- **After the wedding:** Some men wear the same ring from the engagement all the way through marriage. Others move the engagement ring to their right hand, stack it with a new wedding band, or retire the engagement ring entirely.[[1]](https://www.jared.com/mens-engagement-ring-guide)[[2]](https://nelsoncoleman.com/blogs/blog/do-men-wear-engagement-rings-a-look-at-history-culture-and-changing-traditions)[[3]](https://www.reeds.com/do-men-wear-engagement-rings.html)[[4]](https://mirojewelers.com/blogs/our-blogs/do-men-wear-engagement-rings)
